title: Bayesian Optimization of High-Dimensional Scientific Experiments in Isolated Sandboxes
summary: Autonomous experimentation engines frequently struggle with combinatorial hyperparameter exploration. We propose a constrained Bayesian optimization architecture executed inside resource-capped subprocess sandboxes. By fitting sparse Gaussian process surrogates with Matérn-5/2 kernels, the method discovers optimal experimental configurations in 41.5% fewer iterations than standard genetic algorithms while enforcing hard memory ceilings.
